name: Hoyos del Espino (Spain)
description: Tierced and indented at the hoist, red with three yellow wheels, the fly yellow with a green pine and a white saw.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 30 June 2005 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 141 of 21 July 2005); the flag is of 2:3, tierced and indented at the hoist, red with three yellow wheels, the fly yellow with a green pine overlaid by a white saw.

features.role: pine with a white saw across its trunk
